answer_1.quote: Our data collection focuses on summarization of documents in three languages: English (EN), Chinese (ZH), and Indonesian (ID).

answer_2.quote: We investigate the extent to which ROUGE and BERTScore, as well as GPT-4 ratings, reflect human assessments of summaries.

answer_3.quote: We conduct the same ranking experiment using GPT-4 and prompt it for its preference over all possible summary pairs.

answer_4.quote: Annotators are presented with all 10 summaries in a pairwise fashion, for a total of 45 pairs. For each pair, they are asked to compare them according to the following four annotation dimensions: (1) Self-Contained ... (2) Fluency ... (3) Accuracy ... (4) Subjective Preference.
answer_4.guideline: For each pair, annotators compare the two summaries according to the four dimensions: Self-Contained, Fluency, Accuracy, and Subjective Preference.
